seoTitle: When Is Black Friday 2026 UK? Dates for Every Retailer
title: When is Black Friday 2026 in the UK? Dates for Amazon, Argos, Currys, Boots and more
description: Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, with Cyber Monday on 30 November. Which UK retailers' sales have started, and when the rest begin.
intro:
**Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November, and Cyber Monday is on Monday 30 November.** But several big UK retailers have already started: Currys, Boots and AO went live on 28 October, Argos followed on 30 October, and Very started on 2 November. Amazon still hasn't announced its Black Friday Week.

This page tracks each retailer's dates and is updated as they announce. Last checked: 7 November 2026.
body:
## Black Friday 2026 UK: the key dates

- **Black Friday:** Friday 27 November 2026
- **Cyber Monday:** Monday 30 November 2026
- **Amazon Black Friday Week (predicted):** around 19 or 20 November to 30 November
- **Earliest retailer sales:** already live at Currys, Boots and AO (from 28 October) Argos (from 30 October) and Very (from 2 November)

## Which Black Friday 2026 sales have started?

**Already live (confirmed):**

- **Currys:** live since **28 October**, running to **1 December**. Its price promise covers Black Friday products bought between 28 October and 24 November: if Currys cuts the price before 1 December, it refunds the difference.
- **Boots:** live since **28 October**, with over 3,000 products. Boots also runs weekly Star Gifts alongside it.
- **AO:** live since **28 October**, running to **1 December**.
- **Argos:** live from **30 October to 1 December**. Badged items carry a price guarantee until Christmas Day. See our [Argos Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/argos-black-friday-2026/).
- **B&Q:** live from **30 October to 30 November**.
- **Very:** runs from **Monday 2 November to Friday 4 December**, according to its Black Friday page. See our [Very Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/very-black-friday-2026/).
- **John Lewis:** Black Friday deals are already showing and expected to run through November, though John Lewis hasn't published official start dates. It matches prices at 25 big-name rivals, and you can claim up to seven days after buying.
- **Superdrug:** early online fragrance offers are on now. The full sale runs from **Wednesday 4 November to Tuesday 1 December**.
- **Decathlon and Oodie:** both opened their Black Friday sales to everyone on 2 November.

**Not announced yet (as of 7 November):**

- **Amazon:** no dates yet. Which? reported on 5 November that Amazon's official Black Friday sale was still to come, and we found no announcement by 7 November. In 2025, Black Friday Week ran from **20 November to 1 December**, and Amazon announced it on 13 November. Its last three announcements came on 2, 8 and 13 November, so expect the 2026 dates in the first half of November. See our [Amazon Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) on timing a trial so you get Prime-only prices.
- **Ninja and Shark:** their shared Black Friday page only offers a sign-up for now. Amazon and Argos usually match their prices once they start.
- **Dyson, M&S and Debenhams:** no 2026 dates yet; Dyson's Black Friday page still shows last year's details. Lookfantastic has early '20% off selected beauty' offers but no official dates. M&S is usually one of the last to start.

## Do the best deals come early or on the day?

For most products, the lowest prices land in the **last week before Black Friday**, when Amazon's Black Friday Week starts and the other big retailers match it. Early November deals are often genuine, but they're rarely the lowest prices of the season. Two exceptions: **advent calendars** and **toys** sell out, so buy them early.

Brand by brand, our guides show which prices to wait for: [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/), [air fryers](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), [TVs](/guides/tv-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) and more on our [Black Friday hub](/black-friday/).

### What date is Black Friday 2026 in the UK?

Friday 27 November 2026. It's always the Friday after the American Thanksgiving holiday.

### When is Cyber Monday 2026?

Monday 30 November 2026. Many Black Friday deals carry on until then, and some retailers add extra online offers.

### When do Amazon Black Friday deals start in 2026?

Amazon hadn't announced it as of 7 November. Based on recent years, expect Black Friday Week to start around 19 or 20 November and run to Cyber Monday, with the announcement in early to mid November.

### Is it worth waiting for Black Friday?

For tech, vacuums, kitchen gadgets and Amazon devices, usually yes. For things that sell out, like advent calendars, popular toys and limited gift sets, buy when you see a good price.

### Are Black Friday deals real?

Some are, and many aren't. Consumer group Which? has repeatedly found that most Black Friday 'deals' were the same price or cheaper at other times. Our [Black Friday guide](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/) explains how to check a price in 30 seconds.
